description: This header file defines structures, constants, and a function prototype for an Android effects factory, including effect and sub-effect management, effect retrieval, and library handling.

classes.name: list_elem_t
classes.description: Linked list element for generic objects.

classes.name: list_sub_elem_t
classes.description: Linked list element for storing effects with their sub effects.

classes.name: lib_entry_t
classes.description: Represents a loaded effect library with its effects and synchronization lock.

classes.name: effect_entry_t
classes.description: Represents an effect instance with interface and associated library.

classes.name: lib_failed_entry_t
classes.description: Stores information about failed library loads.

classes.name: sub_effect_entry_t
classes.description: Stores a sub effect's library reference and object.

methods.name: EffectGetSubEffects
methods.description: Retrieves descriptors of sub effects for a given effect UUID.
